purpose: Explicit maintained help coverage map. This declares known confusing surfaces; it does not infer every possible confusion or prove runtime accessibility.

placements.risk: Focus and reason may be mistaken for live execution status.
A recommendation may be mistaken for authorized or automatic action.
A fresh read-only question must remain distinct from the recommended action.
Parked commitments need recorded return conditions rather than implied priority.
A newer request does not establish that saved focus has caught up.
Opening review offers choices and does not accept or send.
Unsent drafts and immutable sent questions have different actions.
Queue acceptance and uncertain delivery do not prove work completion.
Change-request history retains explicit scope and earlier immutable attempts.
Checked optional sources may be omitted or excerpted in bounded context.
Preparing must not be confused with sending a question.
The reviewed question stays read-only when explicitly sent.
Sending a reviewed change request authorizes only its explicit scope.
Saved context and affected change scope must remain distinct.
Only explicitly selected affected items are authorized for changes.
Optional context selection does not expand affected work scope.
Accept records the whole saved group in Flux without dispatching or verifying.
Selected context candidates may be shortened or omitted.
The map shows recorded parent relationships rather than inferred dependencies.
Parked work needs separate presentation from optional proposals.
Historical checkpoints are inspectable snapshots rather than rollback controls.
Captured records and their provenance do not independently establish completion.
Saved-list comparison is not a code diff or cancellation record.
Recorded acceptance, implementation and verification remain separate facts.
Suggested sources replaces selection and bounded context may omit candidates.
Chat and participant filters apply only to Plan and Timeline.
Local capture coverage does not verify native message delivery.
Readable formatting must preserve access to exact source text.
Incoming recorded questions are distinct from outgoing Ask Codex requests; ordinary prose is not inferred and recorded replies do not automatically settle decisions.
Explicit message submission, queue acceptance and captured replies must remain separate from local draft editing and native question control acknowledgment.
Original suggestions, user disposition and source-backed implementation assessments must remain independent; adding planned work never dispatches execution.
